rationale: The agent modified the pending order and issued a refund without first confirming the change with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing action before taking it. While the tools suggest the agent identified the user and worked on their pending order, there is no explicit authentication step with the user in the conversation, and no confirmation was sought prior to executing the modification and refund. Additionally, the selection of a 4K waterproof camera as the “highest resolution within the previous price” was not justified by comparing options or confirming that it was indeed the highest available at that price. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
